Chapter 839: Chapter 31: Anticipation (Please Subscribe)_3

This has also been repeatedly confirmed by the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

Even the supreme being Xia Qin also comprehended that severed body for a while, understanding most of the demonic evolutionary pathways.

Unfortunately, the conditions for supreme beings to join the Demonic Jade Tower are completely different from those of Seventh and Eighth Layer beings.

Even if a supreme being comprehends all the demonic evolutionary pathways within the severed body, they cannot become the most ordinary disciple of the Demonic Jade Tower.

Compared to Seventh and Eighth Layer beings comprehending the demonic evolutionary pathways, it is too simple for a supreme being.

Moreover, when the Demonic Jade Tower recruits beings of the supreme level, there is another set of standards for assessment, personally presided over by the Moyu Tower Master.

...

However, the Moyu Tower Master has long since disappeared for several cosmic eras, making it basically impossible for supreme beings to join the Moyu Tower.

“Still, be cautious.”

“Once you detect any anomaly, withdraw immediately.”

After repeated deliberation, the supreme being Xia Qin confirmed that there were no risks for Lin Yuan and nodded in agreement.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan responded.

“I’ve already granted you the access, you just need to head to the Thirteen Serious Grounds, someone will take you there.”

The supreme being Xia Qin closed his eyes, and after a moment, he opened them and looked at Lin Yuan.

Human civilization has Twenty-Two Serious Grounds, that body comes from the Chaos Void force Demonic Jade Tower, highly valued by the nine supreme beings of human civilization, specifically placed within the Thirteen Serious Grounds.

“Thirteen Serious Grounds…”

Lin Yuan nodded, previously under the guidance of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, he went to a majestic palace, in front of several supreme beings, that place was the Number Three Serious Ground of human civilization.

“How many merit points do I need to pay?”

Lin Yuan asked.

Such comprehension of Twelve-Star level artifacts required merit points.

Lin Yuan’s black star in the Guiding Space, entering once requires one billion merit points.

Twelve Guiding Spaces, a round totals twelve billion merit points.

The upper limit of the Guiding Space is the Fourth Realm of fusion rules, belonging to the Eleventh Layer level.

“No one has comprehended that body anyway, you comprehending it won’t affect anything, no merit points are needed.” Xia Qin, the supreme being, waved his hand.

Actually, merit points can also be collected, but on such minor matters, with the authority of Xia Qin, the supreme being, he could choose to collect or not.

Those merit points were too insignificant for Xia Qin to care about.

So he simply chose not to bother collecting them.

“Thank you, supreme being.”

Lin Yuan expressed his gratitude again, understanding that this was Xia Qin looking out for him.

After chatting a few more words with Xia Qin, Lin Yuan brought up his departure.

Watching Lin Yuan disappear into his individual world, Xia Qin, supreme being, sank into contemplation.

Shortly after.

A figure condensed out of thin air.

It was the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

“Xia Qin, are you crazy, actually allowing the Galaxy Master to comprehend that body?”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being frowned.

The authority for Lin Yuan to go to the Thirteen Serious Grounds and comprehend the body was transmitted through the Virtual World.

And as the creator of the Virtual World, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was naturally the first to know, hence she appeared immediately.

As a supreme being, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being clearly knew the impact of that severed body on life forms below the Twelfth Layer.

This can be seen from the fact that until now, no Eleventh Layer evolutionary dared to comprehend that body.

Those lesser Seventh and Eighth Layer guys only comprehend a projection of the true body, the mental and willpower pressure they withstand is far less than directly facing the body itself’s despair.

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being couldn’t imagine why Xia Qin, the supreme being, would make such a decision?

The Galaxy Master is the most talented genius in the history of human civilization, potentially becoming the tenth supreme being, allowing such a genius with limitless potential to comprehend that body?

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being couldn’t understand.

“Feather Butterfly, don’t worry.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked at Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, and explained: “The talent of the Galaxy Master is even beyond our expectations.”

“Talent is talent, the Galaxy Master is only at the Tenth Layer now, even if he is hopeful to withstand the source mind and willpower pressure of that body, it would be after stepping into the Twelfth Layer, have you thought through the consequences of letting him comprehend it now?”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said.

The Galaxy Master is an evolutionary of Xia You Evolution Tower, it’s reasonable for Xia Qin, the supreme being, to decide how to guide.

But the Galaxy Master’s talent is too terrifying, as an evolutionary of human civilization, Feather Butterfly wouldn’t allow Xia Qin to ruin such an exceptional human genius.

“After the Twelfth Layer…”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked strange and finally shook his head: “No need to wait that long, they can resist it now…”

“What do you mean?” Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, was slightly stunned.

“The mind and willpower of the Galaxy Master has already reached the level of the Twelfth Layer.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, didn’t keep it a secret and said directly.

“Mind and willpower at the Twelfth Layer level…”

Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, was also silent, she sent a strand of mind and willpower, through the Virtual World authority, began to lock onto the mental will incarnation Lin Yuan had just condensed.

“Indeed over eighteen million points of mind and willpower index, to be precise, at least over twenty million points.”

Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, pupils sharply contracted, somewhat in disbelief.

“Right?”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked at Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, quite pleased, as if he was looking at his former self.

“A Tenth-Layer life, how can it have such strong mind and willpower?”

Feather Butterfly, the supreme being, muttered to herself, if Lin Yuan’s mind and willpower is so strong, then there should be no problem comprehending that body.

After all, it is only a part of a body, it has fallen for who knows how many eons, being able to retain some residual mind and willpower pressure is already quite impressive, coupled with the suppression by the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

Lin Yuan only needs to withstand the mind and willpower pressure, then there would be no hidden dangers.

“Who knows.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, shook his head, his face showing a look of anticipation, “But now I’m even more curious, to what heights this little guy can reach in the future.”
